name: kestrel-player
description: Kestrel Player – IPTV playlist player for Android TV and phones (bring your own Xtream or M3U playlist)

scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
